ops.text: 2026-07-26 ~16:20Z — desired-set surgery tool built, reviewed, and preserved. The bbolt repair tool (dkservicefix: dump + fix modes, Option-B semantics — delete both desired and applied records for every session-keyed label; 0600/regular-file/absolute-path guards, 3s flock timeout, idempotent) dry-ran clean against a checksummed copy of yasyf-home's real services.db: exactly one keyed label (com.github.yasyf.synckit.helper.reposync, Background, desired-only), replacement bucket empty. Source attached here (main.go — standalone module, sole dep go.etcd.io/bbolt v1.5.0; rebuild with CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64) because the working artifacts live in /tmp, which macOS sweeps after ~3 days. The tool is an interim workaround for the desired-set recovery fatality (backlog 002e2e9a); the v0.20.9 drift-arm fix makes it obsolete once deployed. Surgery + the real cell test (synckitd install with 0.36.3 keyless emission) dispatched to yasyf-home.
